description:
FFmpeg is a complete, cross-platform solution to record, convert and stream audio and video. It includes libavcodec - the leading audio/video codec library.
As it is native code, you will need to use P/Invoke or a wrapper library to use it from .NET.
summary: FFmpeg is a complete, cross-platform solution to record, convert and stream audio and video
title: Endpne.FFmpeg.Windows
